integrity.claim_scope: A single rank-four Dynkin type and its 12-root antichain simplicial complex.
integrity.verification: Exact finite root-coordinate enumeration, five explicit free-face collapses, a sphere-plus-tree homotopy argument, and independent mod-two boundary ranks.

scientific_limitations: The classification is proved for the type-D4 root poset only; no generalization to higher rank is claimed.
The source reports reduced integral homology groups but does not supply the new explicit homotopy splitting.
Unindexed equivalent research under nonnesting or antichain-complex terminology cannot be ruled out.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: The \(D_4\) root-poset antichain complex: an octahedral sphere and five circles
